description:
Cross-source property facts with provenance and unresolved attributes.
    Review floor area, bedrooms and tenure with the user before a valuation.
    `ml_primary` and `imputed` are predictions, not measurements; a warehouse
    value is not automatically declared. `eligible_as_primary: false` marks
    context only: EPC habitable rooms are not bedrooms, occupier tenure is not
    legal tenure, and price-derived areas are not measurements. The AVM back-
    series is scaled from its headline, not independent corroboration. Keep
    user confirmations labelled as user-supplied and unknown facts unknown.
    UK only. Costs 15 credits (15p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_reconcile
title: Reconcile a property across sources
